_note: Ground truth for real Appendix 3Y/3Z forms, read independently of the
rules extractor and checked by a second reader. Used to measure
criterion 1.1 (>=98% field accuracy on identifiers and quantities).

documents.notes:
Form is an Appendix 3Z (Final Director's Interest Notice), not a 3Y — it has no "Date of change", "Nature of change", "Number acquired/disposed", "Value/Consideration", or closed-period sections at all. Those fields are absent from the document, not blank.

3Z-specific field a 3Y-oriented parser has no slot for: "Date that director ceased to be director" = "18 August 2026". A date-hunting regex will likely mistake this for a date of change. Note it post-dates the "Date of last notice" (27 October 2025) by ~10 months.

qty_before/qty_after left empty deliberately. There is no before/after structure on a 3Z, and no line is labelled "ordinary" or "fully paid ordinary" anywhere. Holdings as printed:
- Part 1 (director is registered holder), "Number & class of securities": "Nil" — a word, not a numeral; a numeric regex will return nothing or zero-fill incorrectly.
- Part 2 (director is NOT registered holder), split across two holders with (A)/(B) enumeration in BOTH columns, which must be matched pairwise across cells: "(A) 3,326,667 shares" and "(B) 500,000 shares". Class is stated only as "shares" — never "ordinary" — so it cannot be attributed to the ordinary class without inference. The (A)/(B) enumeration is also not a transaction enumeration; a parser that counts "1./2./(A)/(B)" markers as transactions will wrongly report 2 here.

Malformed holder text in Part 2 (A): "Sunshine Group Investments Pty Ltd <Sunshine Group Inv Fam A/C – Director" — the angle bracket is opened but never closed, and the words "– Director" (the nature of interest) run on inside the same cell after the account designation. Holder (B) "James Dack Real Estate Pty Ltd <James Dack Super Fund A/C>" is correctly closed. Any <...> account-designation regex that requires a closing ">" will fail on (A) or greedily swallow into (B). Holder names also wrap mid-name across lines with justified spacing in (B) ("James  Dack  Real  Estate  Pty" — multiple internal spaces), so whitespace must be collapsed.

Part 3 (Director's interests in contracts): all four fields read "N A" — with a space, not "N/A" or "NA". A regex looking for "N/A" or "Nil" will treat these as populated values.

Boilerplate dates that can be mis-captured: "Rule 3.19A.3", "Introduced 30/9/2001." and the footer/header "11/3/2002" (form version date) appear on both pages; "11/3/2002" is a bare DD/MM/YYYY string and is the highest false-positive risk for a date extractor.

Two pages; no covering letter, no signature block, no lodgement/date-signed field.

documents.direct_or_indirect: Both: Part 1 "Direct interest" (registered holder); Part 2 indirect — "Mr Kelly is a controller of Dalraida Holdings Pty Ltd."

There is no "Date of change"; instead "Date that director ceased to be director  19 August 2026" (verbatim). Note the odd chronology: date of last notice 4 July 2025 precedes cessation 19 August 2026, and the form's own template footer dates read "Introduced 30/9/2001." and "11/3/2002" (form template dates, not event dates) — a naive date regex will pick these up. Part 1 lists TWO classes in one cell as a lettered list: a) 8,991,870 Fully Paid Ordinary Shares; b) 1,621,622 Unlisted Options Ex $0.04, expiring 27 June 2028 — the "$0.04" is an option exercise price and must not be read as consideration. Holdings cells contain several security classes each: before-change lists 7 lines (2,885,833 Fully paid ordinary shares; 106,838 STI Performance Rights; "427, 350 LTI Performance Rights" — note the stray space inside the number as printed; 3,000,000 Production Incentive Rights; 164,722 FY25 STI Performance Rights; 658,889 FY25 LTI Performance Rights; 121,147 FY26 LTI Performance Rights), after-change lists 5 lines (2,420,021 Fully paid ordinary shares; 3,000,000 Production Incentive Rights; 164,722 FY25 STI Performance Rights; 658,889 FY25 LTI Performance Rights; 121,147 FY26 LTI Performance Rights) — the STI/LTI Performance Rights lines vanish entirely after change rather than going to zero. A separate "Class" cell lists three classes: STI Performance Rights / LTI Performance Rights / Fully paid ordinary shares. Number disposed item 1 has a stray comma inside the text: "106,838, STI Performance Rights". Number disposed item 1 is the SAME event as Number acquired item 1 (rights converted into ordinary shares), so the two numbered disposal items do not equal two disposals of ordinary shares; Nature of change enumerates exactly 2 transactions (conversion of vested rights, on-market trades), which is the transaction_count used. Ordinary-share arithmetic: 2,885,833 + 534,188 - 1,000,000 = 2,420,021 (consistent). Value/Consideration is enumerated 1./2.: item 1 is "nil consideration" (no dollar figure), item 2 states "$6,410,050" as the total received for shares sold — reported in consideration_aud as the only dollar figure on the form, but be aware it covers only the disposal leg, not the whole form. documents.nature_of_change_text: Off-market transfer from family trust to superannuation fund (no overall change in holdings)
documents.notes:
TWO HOLDING VEHICLES, NOT TWO TRANSACTIONS. "Nature of indirect interest" enumerates two registered holders: "(1) Mr Michael John Kitney & Mrs Dale Jayne Kitney <Emdale Family A/C>" and "(2) Kitney SMSF Pty Ltd <Kitney Super Fund A/C>". Every quantity cell is keyed by that (1)/(2) holder index, NOT by transaction number — a regex that treats "(1) ... (2) ..." as enumerated transactions will double-count. Nature of change describes a single off-market transfer between the two vehicles, so transaction_count = 1.

NET-ZERO POSITION CHANGE. The form is explicit: "(no overall change in holdings)". Disposal of 2,000,000 ordinary from holder (1) and acquisition of 2,000,000 ordinary by holder (2). Note the counter-intuitive ordering: "Number acquired" is tagged (2) and "Number disposed" is tagged (1) — the holder index does not follow the acquired/disposed order.

qty_before / qty_after LEFT EMPTY DELIBERATELY. No single ordinary-share figure is stated; the ordinary line appears twice, once per holder, and summing them would be computation. Verbatim values:
  No. of securities held prior to change — (1) a. 2,000,000 / b. 1,500,000 / c. 750,000 / d. 750,000; (2) a. nil
  No. of securities held after change — (1) a. nil / b. 1,500,000 / c. 750,000 / d. 750,000; (2) a. 2,000,000
Only the "a." rows are ordinary; b/c/d are unlisted options.

MULTIPLE CLASSES IN ONE CELL, LETTER-KEYED. Class cell reads: (1) a. Fully paid ordinary shares; b. $0.075 unlisted options exp. 1 Dec 2027; c. $0.10 unlisted options exp. 1 Dec 2028; d. $0.12 unlisted options exp. 1 Dec 2029; (2) a. Fully paid ordinary shares. Quantities are matched to classes only by the a/b/c/d letter key in a parallel cell — positional line-pairing across cells is required, and the (2) block has only one lettered row while (1) has four.

"nil" IS USED WHERE A PARSER MAY EXPECT 0 — appears in both the prior-change and after-change cells.

DOLLAR AMOUNTS INSIDE CLASS STRINGS. "$0.075", "$0.10", "$0.12" are option exercise prices, not consideration. A greedy currency regex over the page will hit these before the real Value/Consideration figure of $40,000.00. The $40,000.00 is a single stated total (no per-share price given) and is not sub-divided between the two holders.

CLOSED PERIOD ANSWER INCLUDES A FULL STOP: the cell reads "No." not "No". The two follow-up closed-period cells read "N/A".

Part 2 (contracts) is "N/A" in all eight cells.

DATES ARE LONG-FORM, NOT ISO: "19 June 2026" (last notice), "17 August 2026" (this notice), "14 August 2026" (change). Date of change is a single date, not a range. Note the date of last notice (19 June 2026) is only ~2 months before this notice.

"For personal use only" appears as a rotated left-margin watermark on both pages and is injected into the extracted text stream at the end of page 1 and page 2 — strip it before field matching.

Header/footer boilerplate repeats on every page ("Appendix 3Y / Change of Director's Interest Notice", "+ See chapter 19 for defined terms.", "01/01/2011", "Appendix 3Y Page 1/2"), and page 1's extracted text repeats the title block twice.

Typographic apostrophe (U+2019) in "Director's" throughout; "Part 3 – +Closed period" uses an en dash and a leading "+" on the defined term.

Director name inconsistency between fields: header says "Mr Michael Kitney"; the nature-of-interest cell says "Mr Michael John Kitney". Reported director_name is the header value as printed.

documents.nature_of_change_text: Issue of Unlisted Director Options following Shareholder Approval on 9 April 2026
documents.notes:
COVERING LETTER: pages 1 of the PDF is an ASX announcement dated 17 August 2026 ("Correction to Director's Interest Notice") that precedes the Appendix 3Y itself (form starts on PDF page 2). The letter states this 3Y replaces one lodged for Rebekah Letheby on 10 April 2026 and corrects an option expiry date (21 June 2027 -> 15 December 2027) that was mis-stated on the Appendix 3X lodged 14 November 2025. A parser scanning page 1 will find "ACN: 601 164 505" in the letter footer, plus dates 17 August 2026, 10 April 2026, 14 November 2025, 20 December 2024, and option figures 3,000,000 / $0.14 — none of which are the form's fields.

IDENTIFIER: form field is labelled "ABN" with value "44 601 164 505"; the covering letter/footer instead prints "ACN: 601 164 505". Both refer to the same entity (ABN embeds the ACN) but the two labels/values differ in the same document.

MULTIPLE CLASSES IN ONE CELL: "No. of securities held prior to change" contains three lines in one cell — "540,907  fully paid ordinary shares" (note the double space after 540,907), "3,000,000 options exercisable at $0.14 each on or before 15 December 2027", then a bolded sub-heading "Indirect:" followed by "400,000 fully paid ordinary shares". So TWO separate fully paid ordinary share lines appear (540,907 and 400,000); qty_before reported as the first/primary line 540,907. Combined ordinary would be 940,907 if the sub-block is added. Same structure in "No. of securities held after change": 540,907 ordinary, 3,000,000 options ($0.14, on or before 15 December 2027), 7,500,000 unlisted options ("exercisable at $0.14 before 10 April 2028" — note "before", not "on or before"), then "Indirect:" 400,000 fully paid ordinary shares.

CONTRADICTION: "Direct or indirect interest" = "Indirect", yet the securities cells split into an unlabelled top block and a separately labelled "Indirect:" block, implying the top block is direct. The form does not reconcile this.

ORDINARY SHARES NET ZERO: ordinary share counts are identical before and after (540,907 and 400,000 unchanged); the only change is the acquisition of 7,500,000 unlisted options.

NON-STANDARD LABEL: the disposal row is labelled "Number disposed/Lapsed" (not the standard "Number disposed").

DASHES NOT ZEROS: "Number disposed/Lapsed" and "Value/Consideration" both contain a bare hyphen "-", not "0" or "Nil". No dollar total is stated anywhere in Part 1; $0.14 is an exercise price, not consideration.

PART 2: "Detail of contract" = "NA"; every other Part 2 row is blank.

PART 3: closed period = "No"; the two follow-up rows = "N/A".

DATE OF LAST NOTICE (23 December 2025) is inconsistent with the covering letter's narrative, which references a 3Y lodged 10 April 2026 and a 3X lodged 14 November 2025.

Extracted page text has heading/footer fragments run together and missing spaces (e.g. "No. ofsecurities held after change", "Change of Director'sInterest Notice", "Name ofregistered holder", "Part 3 –\n+Closed period", "-ENDSFor further information"), and page-footer text ("01/01/2011 Appendix 3Y Page 1") appears at the top of the extracted page. Curly apostrophes are used throughout ("Director's"). Angle brackets appear in the holder name: "<Letheby Charles A/C>".

documents.notes:
TWO COMPLETE APPENDIX 3Y FORMS IN ONE PDF. Pages 1-3 = Alex Rovira (reported above); pages 4-6 = a second, separate Appendix 3Y for director Andrew Rich, same entity (BRIGHTSTAR RESOURCES LIMITED, ABN 44 100 727 491), date of last notice 12 March 2026, direct-or-indirect "Indirect", registered holder "Mr Andrew Rich <Rich Family A/C>", date of change "1. 17 August 2026 / 2. 13 August 2026", number acquired "1. 100,000", number disposed "2. 42,857", consideration "1. $42,000 (non-cash) 2. N/A vesting conditions not met", 2 transactions, Part 3 all N/A. Its page footers restart at "Appendix 3Y Page 1", so a page-number-based splitter will see the numbering reset mid-file. A parser that reads the whole PDF as one form will mix the two directors' numbers.

Other traps in the reported (first) form:
- Enumeration keys are INCONSISTENT WITHIN THE SAME FORM: holders/entities are numbered 1./2./3. (Nature of indirect interest, No. of securities held prior/after), but dates and transactions are lettered A./B. (Date of change, Class, Number acquired, Number disposed, Value/Consideration, Nature of change). The "1." in the holdings blocks does NOT correspond to the "A." in the transaction blocks.
- Date of change is TWO dates (A. 17 August 2026, B. 13 August 2026), not one, and they are not in chronological order.
- "Direct or indirect interest" cell contains "Indirect" plus a parenthetical holder name over two lines — it names only Sol Sal Investments, whereas the Nature-of-indirect-interest cell lists three separate holders (Sol Sal Investments Pty Ltd <Sol Sal Investments A/C>, Las Olas Investments Pty Ltd, AR Super WA Pty Ltd).
- Holdings cells contain MULTIPLE SECURITY CLASSES AND MULTIPLE HOLDERS in one cell. Prior: holder 1 = 2,842,857 Ordinary fully paid shares + 178,571 Share Performance Rights expiring 31 December 2027 + 2,500,000 Share Performance Rights expiring 31 December 2029; holder 2 = 835,190 Ordinary fully paid shares; holder 3 = 372,000 Ordinary fully paid shares. After: holder 1 = 2,967,857 Ordinary fully paid shares + 2,500,000 Share Performance Rights expiring 31 December 2029 (the 31 Dec 2027 rights line disappears entirely rather than showing zero); holder 2 = 835,190; holder 3 = 372,000. qty_before/qty_after above are the holder-1 ordinary line only (the only ordinary line that changes); NO single aggregate ordinary total is stated anywhere on the form, so any total would have to be computed.
- Bullet/dash prefixes ("- 2,842,857 Ordinary fully paid shares") appear only in holder 1's block, not holders 2 and 3.
- Value/Consideration: $52,500 is stated for transaction A only and is flagged "(non-cash)"; transaction B has no dollar figure ("N/A vesting conditions not met"). So $52,500 is the only dollar figure on the form but is NOT a total across both transactions.
- Transaction B is a lapse/cessation of performance rights ("conditions unable to be satisfied") recorded under "Number disposed" — a disposal with no counterparty and no consideration.
- Part 2 (contracts) and Part 3 (closed period) are all "N/A" — Part 3 is not a yes/no answer, so closed_period is recorded as "na", not "no".
- A vertical "For personal use only" watermark is interleaved into the extracted text of every page and will appear mid-field for naive text extraction.
- Document control string "3461-0342-1486, v. 1" appears in the footer of PDF pages 2 and 3 (and again on the second form's pages) and can be mistaken for an identifier.
- ABN is printed with spaces: "44 100 727 491".

Holdings are split into two lines in one cell — "237,876 (Direct)" and "496,757 (Indirect)" before, "242,080 (Direct)" and "505,537 (Indirect)" after — so no single ordinary-securities figure is stated; qty_before/qty_after left empty rather than summing (237,876+496,757=734,633 and 242,080+505,537=747,617 would be computed, not printed). Class cell reads "Ordinary securities" (not "fully paid ordinary shares"); only one class on the form. Number acquired cell holds two figures, each with an embedded parenthesised date, plus Direct/Indirect labels. The first reading is substantially correct and every scalar field is confirmed: Appendix 3Z (Final Director's Interest Notice), "AXP Energy Limited", ABN 98 114 198 471, director "James Dack", "Date of last notice 27 October 2025" -> 2025-10-27, transaction_count 0. CONFIRMED TRAPS
- 3Z-only field with no 3Y slot: "Date that director ceased to be director" = "18 August 2026". Highest risk of being mis-bound to date_of_change. Left out of date_of_change deliberately.
- File sits under fixtures/app3y/ but is a 3Z. Directory name is not evidence of form type.
- Part 1 "Number & class of securities" = "Nil" (word, not numeral).
- Part 2 holdings, (A)/(B) enumerated in BOTH columns and must be matched pairwise: "(A) 3,326,667 shares", "(B) 500,000 shares". Class is written only as "shares" — the strings "ordinary" and "fully paid ordinary" appear nowhere in the document.
- qty_before/qty_after correctly left empty. A 3Z has no before/after structure, and the (A)+(B) sum of 3,826,667 must NOT be back-filled into qty_after: it is not attributable to the ordinary class without inference, and a substantive default here would be wrong.
- The (A)/(B) markers are holder enumeration, not transaction enumeration. A parser counting them as transactions wrongly reports 2.
- Malformed Part 2 (A): "Sunshine Group Investments Pty Ltd <Sunshine Group Inv Fam A/C – Director" — angle bracket opened, never closed. (B) "James Dack Real Estate Pty Ltd <James Dack Super Fund A/C>" closes correctly. A greedy <...> regex will swallow from (A) into (B). (B) also wraps mid-name with justified multi-space runs ("James  Dack  Real  Estate  Pty"), so whitespace must be collapsed.
- Part 3: all four cells read "N A" — space, not "N/A" or "NA". A "N/A"/"Nil" matcher treats these as populated.
- Two pages; no covering letter, no signature block, no date-signed/lodgement field.

CORRECTED: three points in the first reading.
1. The first reading attributes "– Director" as "the nature of interest" for Part 2 without qualification. It belongs to holder (A) ONLY; holder (B) carries no nature-of-interest text at all. A pairwise parser must not carry "Director" across to (B) — (B)'s nature of interest is unstated and should be recorded as unknown, not inherited from (A).
2. "Rule 3.19A.3" is listed in the first reading among "boilerplate dates that can be mis-captured". It is a listing-rule reference, not a date. The genuine boilerplate dates are "Introduced 30/9/2001." and the version stamp "11/3/2002". The first reading's assessment of "11/3/2002" is otherwise right — it appears in the page-1 footer ("11/3/2002  Appendix 3Z Page 1") and again in the page-2 footer ("Appendix 3Z Page 2  11/3/2002"), i.e. twice, in footers, not in headers.
3. "post-dates the Date of last notice ... by ~10 months" — the actual gap from 27 October 2025 to 18 August 2026 is 9 months 22 days. Trivial, but the framing matters: a ceased-date later than the last notice is the normal ordering on a 3Z, not an anomaly to flag. (Reading run date 2026-08-19, so cessation was the prior day.)

direct_or_indirect deliberately left empty: a 3Z has no direct/indirect field. The split is inferable from structure (Part 1 direct = Nil; Part 2 indirect = 3,826,667 across two holders) but must not be synthesized into a transaction-level field when no transaction is described.

That is not an anomaly — it is the required and expected ordering on every 3Z, since the last notice necessarily predates the director leaving the board. Flagging it as odd would make a validator raise a false alarm on essentially every 3Z in the corpus; the correct anomaly rule is the reverse test (last notice AFTER cessation). Note also that cessation 19 August 2026 is the current date, so event_date and knowable_at coincide here. CORRECTED: the first reading listed only "30/9/2001" and "11/3/2002" as date-regex traps but missed a third and more dangerous one — "expiring 27 June 2028" inside Part 1 item b). That is an option expiry date sitting in the securities cell, closer to the extraction target than either footer, and a date-picker scanning the Part 1 block will grab it. CORRECTED (scope flag, not a transcription error): qty_after = 8,991,870 is correctly transcribed but is the DIRECT registered holding only. The director's total ordinary-share relevant interest at cessation is 74,111,870 (8,991,870 direct + 65,120,000 indirect) — the indirect parcel is 7.2x the direct one, so any consumer reading qty_after as "total ordinary shares held at cessation" understates it by 65,120,000.
